content.text: {"id": "mm5113a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The prevalence of any alcohol use among pregnant women increased from 12.4% in 1991 to 16.3 % in 1995"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "binge drinking rates were 2.9% in 1995, 1.8% in 1997, and 2.7% in 1999"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "binge drinking rates were 2.9% in 1995, 1.8% in 1997, and 2.7% in 1999"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "rates remained stable: 53.2% in 1995, 52.8% in 1997, and 53.3% in 1999."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Compared with 1995 data, prevalence was lower in 1997 (11.4%) and 1999 (12.8%)"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "ocr", "q": "* Adjusted for age, race, education, employment, and marital status."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed representative survey data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) during 1991--1999"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Linear regression models were used to examine temporal trends."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Linear regression models were used to examine temporal trends."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Multivariate logistic analysis was conducted to examine the age, race, education level, employment, and marital status"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Sample data were weighted to reflect general population estimates, and standard errors were calculated by using SUDAAN."}, {"loc": "ocr", "q": "* Adjusted for age, race, education, employment, and marital status."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
